note: Alberta Parks campground in Vermilion Provincial Park on the edge of the Town of Vermilion, operated by the town, beside the Vermilion River reservoir: some sites separated by stands of trees, others open with trees for shade, cook shelter, fish-cleaning station, mini golf, spray park, playground and horseshoe pitch; trails for walking, biking and skiing. Snacks are sold from the registration booth in summer. Water services shut down for the season from mid-September (showers by early October). --Claude

Wrote season (manual), booking season, sites (max 61 ft, pull-throughs), hookups (30 A), facilities; note rewritten. flags: OPERATOR / POLICY_REF: the page names 'Facility Operator: Town of Vermilion' and 'Information: 780-853-4372' (matches stored phone). Unlike the county-leased campground of p3-374, Vermilion books on shop.albertaparks.ca (parkId 330241, contract ABPP, 90-day window shown) at the provincial rate table, so it is inside the provincial system: keep provincial:AB, do not decline it. Ownership provincial stays.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview -> recommend not waterfront): on Esri imagery (about 0.7 m/px) and the tear-sheet map (50 m scale) the nearest sites (Loops B and C) sit about 110-130 m from the reservoir shore with a continuous belt of deciduous woods and the Lakeside Trail between; the shop tags no site 'Near Water'. The agency's 'Camp alongside the Vermilion River Reservoir' is marketing prose. No official campsite photo showing the water was found. Unsure after every source read, so down to not waterfront. The Claude Brennan Trout Pond on the map borders the group camping areas, not the RV loops.
